name: FlexClip
tagline: FlexClip is an online video editor with AI features including text-to-video, AI video script writer, auto-subtitle generator, and background remover for video. It provides thousands of templates for social media, marketing, and presentations, making it ideal for non-designers who need polished video quickly.
